title: Harden the W-1 verify gate tests against shell and defaults overrides, parse the YAML for the SHA-pin count, anchor step 0 (follow-up of WCLI-121)
description: Non-blocking findings from the round-2 Opus review of ward-cli#230 (squash 250d4f4b7ad8a1e64f2cbfbcfe8d123b5ed6a53d, unit ward-cli-review-230b, claude-opus-5-5, APPROVE at f632152), condensed by team-lead, so this is a relay. This task BLOCKS THE PUBLIC FLIP, alongside WCLI-121 role, and is not started: it is a new item for the next plan. Findings: (1) LOW-MEDIUM, predates #230: the codesign step can be neutered without adding a step. steps[2] is anchored only at its first and last line; a `shell: true {0}` line between the step name and its if (release.yml near the codesign step), or a job-level `defaults: run: shell: true {0}` in verify, leaves every test green, and on GitHub custom-shell template the runner executes `true <script>` so the step passes without running codesign (not measured). Fix: anchor steps[2] exactly as steps[1], and assert verify and the top level contain no `shell:` or `defaults:`; the test comment claims more than the tests show. (2) LOW, predates #230: the whole-file SHA-pin count misses flow `- {uses: x@main}`, quoted `"uses":`, two spaces after `uses:`, and a value on the next line, in the build and release jobs; robust fix: parse the YAML (Bun.YAML) and check every jobs.*.steps[*].uses. (3) INFO: steps[0] is anchored only at its start; a tab after the dash merges into it (GitHub likely rejects that YAML, unmeasured); an end anchor closes it. (4) INFO: the runbook line "tag anew, matching package.json at main" implies a version bump without saying so and does not rule out deleting and re-pushing the same tag name.

acceptanceCriteria.text: steps[2] of the verify job is anchored exactly as the download step, and a test fails if verify or the workflow top level gains a shell: or defaults: key
The SHA-pin check parses the workflow YAML and checks every jobs.*.steps[*].uses, so flow, quoted, double-space and next-line spellings are covered
steps[0] of the verify job is anchored at its end as well as its start
The runbook says whether a new version bump is needed and whether the same tag name may be deleted and re-pushed
